channel.description: Understand systems, not trends. A newsletter for engineers who build real products with AI.

item.title: Issue 02: RAG Isn't Dead. Most People Just Don't Understand It.
item.description: Large context windows are useful. Retrieval is useful. The mistake is treating them as the same thing. A long-context model gives you a bigger desk. RAG helps you find the right document before you start working.

item.title: Issue 01: Prompt Engineering Isn't Dead. It's Evolving.
item.description: Everyone is declaring prompt engineering dead. They are wrong. The stack simply grew larger. Technology evolves. Fundamentals compound.
